tasks.title: Désamorcer le bruit "zombie" du widget Alertes SLA (tickets coincés en PREPARING)
tasks.problem: Le widget affiche "156 Alerte(s)" avec des tickets "En attente depuis 10 j 23 h". Structurellement : slaAlerts() liste toute commande au statut PREPARING au-delà de 15 min, et RIEN n'expire automatiquement une commande PREPARING (le cron CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders ne traite que les PENDING kiosk — vérifié app/Console/Kernel.php:105). Donc dès que la cuisine oublie de bumper un ticket ou qu'une commande est abandonnée en cours de prép, elle reste PREPARING indéfiniment et s'accumule. À terme le signal réellement actionnable (un ticket en retard de 15 min à quelques heures, à traiter MAINTENANT) est noyé sous des tickets fantômes vieux de plusieurs jours — le widget se dégrade en bruit permanent. (Le "156" littéral est de la pollution de données de test et ne se reproduira pas ; le défaut structurel, lui, reste.)

tasks.after: Bucketer côté affichage : section "À traiter maintenant" (15 min – 24 h, mise en avant rouge, triée du plus urgent) + une ligne neutre repliée "N anciens tickets (> 24 h)" non-alarmante, et faire porter le badge compteur uniquement sur le bucket actionnable. Le fix de cycle de vie en amont (expiration des PREPARING orphelins) est HORS scope de ce cluster — on traite seulement la lisibilité du cockpit.

tasks.title: Time displays EN-US 12h "11:27 PM" everywhere instead of FR 24h — one env line fixes the whole dashboard
tasks.problem: The transactions table (capture x06) shows '11:27 PM, 03-06-2026' — EN-US 12-hour AM/PM clock, which is wrong for a FR restaurant and clashes with the 24h time shown elsewhere. The gérant reads transaction/order timestamps every day; '11:27 PM' forces a mental conversion and looks broken/non-FR. Root cause: .env:69 sets TIME_FORMAT="h:i A" (12h+AM/PM). AppLibrary::time()/datetime() (app/Libraries/AppLibrary.php:29-43) read env('TIME_FORMAT','H:i'); the env override poisons EVERY backend-formatted timestamp because Transaction/Order/Message resources all call AppLibrary::datetime (TransactionResource.php:38, plus OrderResource/MessageResource/etc.). Config is NOT cached (env() reads live), so the env value is exactly what's rendered live.

tasks.after: .env:69 → TIME_FORMAT="H:i"  → renders '23:27, 03-06-2026' (FR 24h) across every backend-formatted surface in one change. Do NOT touch AppLibrary.php — its default is already 'H:i' (correct); only the env override is wrong. .env.example carries no TIME_FORMAT (verified), so no example-file regression; no test asserts the 12h format (verified grep over tests/).
tasks.v1_value: A single line flips every timestamp the gérant sees (caisse transactions, order history, messages, reports) from a broken EN-US 12h clock to clean FR 24h. Highest leverage-per-character fix in the cluster; display-only, no stored timestamps change (NF525-neutral).

tasks.title: $t('label.'+UPPER_ENUM) casing leaks raw upper-case keys onto receipts when an enum has no fr.json entry
tasks.problem: Three receipt components build i18n keys dynamically from data values — PosOrderReceiptComponent.vue:183, pos/ReceiptComponent.vue:260, OnlineOrderReceiptComponent.vue:194 all do $t('label.' + line.key). If line.key arrives upper-case or as a raw enum (e.g. 'CRUDITE', 'SUPPLEMENT_BOL') and fr.json has no matching key, vue-i18n falls back to printing the raw token (e.g. 'label.SUPPLEMENT_BOL') on a printed receipt the customer/gérant sees. The prior deep audit flagged this token family (W2/W3 FINDINGS) as a recurring i18n leak class. This is a robustness + interface fix: normalize the key (lower-case) and ensure the label.* family is complete in fr.json.

Verify against the real line.key enum values produced by the receipt builder before adding keys (no invented keys).
tasks.v1_value: Prevents raw 'label.X' tokens from appearing on printed/displayed receipts — the gérant's most customer-visible artifact. Fixes a whole class of latent i18n leaks rather than one string, and the casing-normalize makes it resilient to future enum additions.

critic.verdict: Vision-aligned and shippable-to-green, but PADDED BY CROSS-CLUSTER DUPLICATION rather than by gold-plating — the analysts' heavy self-rejection pass already stripped most SaaS-scale fluff, so the true gold-plate rate is ~10% (4 cuts), not 30%. The real waste is that ~15 task ids collapse into ~6 root fixes (time-format, catalogue-money, report-money, TVA-label, Dernier-Z, brand-color); the orchestrator MUST merge these or two clusters will collide on the same .env/AppLibrary/currency_price levers, and must resolve the seed-vs-.env time-format contradiction once. After cutting the PARCOURS over-build (guided closing wizard L-effort + clickable-tiles M/P3), the dormant-channel COMMS-02 polish, and verifying HISTORIQUE-01 isn't a phantom export, the surviving spine is genuine daily money/time/locale warts the gérant sees every service — a clean, honest, scope-minimal GOAL for a single-shop tool.
